evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Framing unrehearsed rollback as nonexistent appeals to security/stability (conservation) and frames rehearsal as the proof of genuine capability (competence).
Cadence commitment appeals to security and stability through regular rehearsal.
Assigning ownership names who is accountable for capability — the competence dimension of the rehearsal practice.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the value move here equating unrehearsed capability with the absence of capability itself?
